question: How can a samaya initiate later become fit for accomplishment?
premises: Progress may occur at another time through purification of the path.
Maintaining the samaya observance is required.
The Anandeshvara text calls such a person a vessel of accomplishment.
inference: By later path-purification and steadfast observance of the samaya, the initiate becomes fit for accomplishment.
plain_english: At another time, through purification of the path and by maintaining the samaya observance, such a person becomes a vessel of accomplishment, as is said in the glorious Anandeshvara.
